verdict.rationale: Fellow offers org-wide retention/recording policies, workspace admin control over MCP tool access, and Super Admin API for workspace-wide visibility, which addresses some admin oversight needs. However, there is no explicit evidence of private-by-default note settings, granular link/folder-level sharing permissions, or a dedicated sharing-audit dashboard for admins. missing for 10: private-by-default note defaults, granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, admin visibility/audit log specifically for shared content.
